cohort: The study enrolled 4,118 pregnant women admitted to the hospital between March 2020 and December 2022.
finding: MASLD during pregnancy is associated with an increased risk of several adverse pregnancy outcomes, with steatotic liver disease (SLD) appearing to play a more critical role than cardiometabolic risk factors (CMRF).
mod_finding: MASLD was associated with an elevated risk of cesarean section.
